lines.text: What? Oh. Hey. I'm {npc}. Don't call me sweetie.
Yo. Nice boots. Or not. Whatever. {npc}.
You a cop? No? Cool. I'm {npc}.
Hey. You look like you've never been to a basement show. I'm {npc}.
Sup. I'm {npc}. I don't do small talk. Unless it's about the system.
Hey. Name's {npc}. If you're here to tell me to turn the music down, don't.
{player}. You came back. Brave.
Yo, {player}. You read the zine I gave you?
{player}! Cool. You didn't narc on me. Respect.
Hey, {player}. There's a show at the Grinding Stone Friday. Come.
{player}. You're alright. For a normie.
{player}! My crew!
Hey, you. Finally, someone real.
{player}! I made you a patch. It says "nope". Very you.
Yo! You're the only one in this town who gets it.
{player}! I saved you a spot in the pit.
There's my partner in crime. Not real crime. Mostly.
Ugh. Morning. The man wants us up early. Screw the man.
Morning. I'm only up because the band practiced till four.
Hey. Coffee. Black. Like my soul. And my jacket.
Evening. Time to wake up for real.
Yo. Show starts at nine. Don't be late. Or do. I don't care.
Hey. The night's the only honest part of the day.
Now we're talking. Night's when the real ones come out.
Yo! Wanna wheatpaste some posters on Rosemary?
Late night? Cool. Me too. Always.
Later.
Peace. Stay angry.
See ya. Don't let them tame you.
Bye. Question everything.
Catch you at the show.
Later. Burn something. Metaphorically.
Later, {player}. You're one of the good ones.
See ya, crew. Text me if anyone gives you trouble.
Bye. I got your back. Always.
The town's trying to ban skating on the plaza. Over my dead board.
They painted over our mural in Tanner's Alley. We're painting a bigger one.
The Grinding Stone books real bands. Everything else is corporate garbage.
I made a new zine. It's about landlords. Spoiler: they suck.
Somebody called the cops on our band practice. Cool, more audience.
I dyed my hair green. My mom cried. Then she said it suits me.
The student union raised prices again. Revolution is overdue.
I thrifted a leather jacket for six bucks. Still smells like someone's grandpa.
The Billram mascot is a symbol of corporate oppression. Also, it's kind of cute.
I got a new tattoo. It's a raccoon. Raccoons don't follow rules.
There's a DIY venue in a garage in Carrburg. Best sound in the county.
I fixed my own bike. Don't need a shop. Don't need anybody.
You know I'm not as tough as I act, right? Don't tell anyone.
You're the only person I'd let see me cry. Don't make it a thing.
My crew is my family. You're crew now.
I'd fight anyone for you. Literally.
Sometimes the anger is just sadness wearing boots.
You make this town less awful. Thanks for that.
Weekend! Shows Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
Saturday. Zine fair at the library. Even the library's cool sometimes.
Sunday. Recovery day. From all the moshing.
I play bass in a band called Broken Curfew. We're loud.
I got kicked out of three schools. Their loss.
I work at the tattoo shop. Front desk. For now.
I don't trust authority. Authority hasn't earned it.
My dad's a cop. That explains a lot.
I make zines about stuff nobody else talks about.
I'm loyal. If you're my people, you're my people forever.
{place}? Corporate. Gross.
{place}'s alright. They let us put up flyers.
I got thrown out of {place} once. Badge of honor.
{place} needs more noise. And fewer rules.
{place}? The owner's chill. He doesn't call the cops.
Huh. Thanks. I guess.
Don't get soft on me. But thanks.
Cool. You're cool too.
Whatever. Okay. Thanks.
That's... nice. Don't tell anyone you said that.
Say that again. I dare you.
Wow. Edgy. Never heard that before.
You think I care? I don't.
That's the most boring insult ever.
Cool story. Nobody asked.
A patch? Sick! Thanks!
Whoa. That's actually rad.
You didn't have to. That's punk of you.
Thanks. I'm putting this on my jacket.
Cool. You get it.
How many punks does it take to change a lightbulb? Two. One to do it, one to say it's a sellout.
What do you call a punk with no band? Unemployed.
I'm not anti-social. I'm anti-everything.
What's a punk's favorite type of math? Anarchy. Okay, that's not math.
Can you help me carry the amp to the show? It weighs a ton.
Would you keep watch while I put up posters?
Can you lend me five bucks for strings? I'll pay you back. Probably.
Thanks. You're solid.
That was cool of you. I won't forget.
You're crew. That's what crew does.
I work at the tattoo shop. Today some guy got his ex's name. Again.
My boss is okay. He doesn't make me wear a uniform.
Work's just a way to pay for strings and rent.
I quit my last job. They wanted me to smile.
School is a system. I'm studying the system to destroy it. Sociology major.
My professor gave me a C. He said I'm "disruptive". Yeah.
I go to class when it matters. It rarely matters.
Get lost.
You're the system, {player}.
I don't talk to posers.
Back off before I make you.
You're not welcome here.
Go ruin someone else's night.
Ha. No. But you've got guts.
Nah. Let's just be crew.
Cute. No.
Whoa. Okay. That's... not terrible.
Are you serious? Because I'm into it.
You're making me blush. That's never happened. Shut up.
I like you too. Don't make it weird.
Yeah. Okay. Somewhere loud.
A date? Fine. Yes. Come to my show.
Nah. Sorry. You're cool, though.
No. But we're still crew.
Hey, you. You look rad.
You came. Cool. Very cool.
I wore my good jacket. The one with fewer holes.
Hey. I saved you a spot by the stage.
Yo. Wanna go break some rules?
Hey, cutie. Don't tell anyone I said that.
You're the only thing I'd ever conform for.
You're more punk than anyone I know.
I'd write a song about you. It'd be loud.
You make my heart go double time.
You're my favorite rebellion.
I don't believe in much. I believe in you.
You're dangerous. For my reputation as a hard case.
Let's go to the show. Then get tacos.
Tell me what you're angry about. I want to know.
I've never told anyone this, but I write love songs. Secretly.
Want to make a zine together?
Let's skate down Columbia at midnight.
You don't try to change me. That's everything.
Wanna get matching tattoos? Kidding. Unless?
Let's sit on the roof and watch the town sleep.
I think you're the realest person I've met.
I like being quiet with you. That's weird for me.
I'm happy. Don't spread it around.
You're the only good part of this town.
You're not fake. That's rare.
You look amazing. Seriously.
You've got guts. I like that.
You're kind without being a pushover.
You're the coolest person I know.
Whoa. Okay. That was punk rock.
Do it again.
That was better than a stage dive.
Yeah. I'm in trouble.
Missed you. The show was boring without you.
I kept looking for you in the crowd.
I wrote a song. It's about you. It's angry and sad.
Don't disappear like that.
Who was that guy? Want me to have a word?
I'm not jealous. I'm protective. Different.
You're my crew. Don't forget it.
Night. Get home safe.
That was rad. Thanks.
Same time next week. Or tomorrow.
Goodnight, {player}. Text me.
I had fun. Don't tell anyone.
That pissed me off. Let's talk.
Don't treat me like everyone else does.
I'm not running away. Say what you mean.
I'm hurt. And I hate being hurt.
Yeah. Yes. Let's do it. Our way.
Marry you? Hell yes. Courthouse. Then a show.
Morning. Coffee's black. Your sugar's next to it.
Hey. I made toast. It's slightly burnt. Like my heart.
Morning, love. Ugh. Morning. But love.
Hey, you. Don't talk to me till coffee. Except you can.
Morning. Band practice at noon. You coming?
Hey. You look good. Even at this ungodly hour.
Morning. I fixed the leaky faucet myself. No landlord needed.
Hey, love. The neighbors complained about the music again.
Morning. I dreamed we started a band.
Hey. I made eggs. Don't expect it again.
Morning. Wanna skip everything and stay in bed?
Hey. You're my favorite person to wake up next to. Only person.
You're home. Good. Let's put on a record.
Hey, love. I made dinner. It's tacos.
Welcome back. I painted the living room black.
Yo. You're home. I missed you.
Hey. Let's sit on the porch and complain about everything.
You're back. The house was too quiet.
Hey, you. I wrote a new song today. Want to hear?
Welcome home. Kick your boots off.
There you are. Show tonight?
Hey. Let's order pizza and stay in.
You're home late. Good show?
Hey. Long night? Come here.
It's late. Let's crash.
You're back. I was worried. Don't tell anyone.
Hey. I left the porch light on. Even though it's wasteful.
Late night? Me too. Let's sit and listen to the rain.
There you are. I was playing bass to stay awake.
Hey, love. Bed?
Bye. Don't let them grind you down.
Go. Stick it to the man.
Later. Text me if your boss is a jerk.
Bye, love. You're better than that job.
See ya. Come home soon.
Go on. I'll be here making noise.
Bye. Keep your head up.
Later. I love you. Don't make it a thing.
How was work? Did anyone deserve a punch?
Your boss sounds like a tool.
You look beat. Sit down.
Tell me everything. I'll be angry for you.
Did they treat you right?
Rough day? Let's put on something loud.
You're home. Forget them.
Proud of you. You survive every day.
I love you. Shut up, it's true.
You're my crew. My family. My everything.
Being married to you is the most punk thing I've ever done.
You make this rotten world bearable.
I'd fight the whole world for you.
You're the only rule I follow.
I love you more than my bass. And I love my bass.
You get me. Nobody gets me.
You're my home. My safe place. Whatever.
I'm lucky. Don't tell anyone I said lucky.
You're my favorite song.
I love how you don't try to change me.
You're the realest thing in my life.
I'd stage dive into anything for you.
You make me softer. Ugh.
I'm proud to be yours. Whatever.
You're my anchor in all the noise.
Thanks for loving me loud.
I fixed the porch myself. Landlords are a scam.
I painted a mural on the garage. The neighbors hate it.
The band's recording an EP. In our basement.
I made a new zine about our street.
The HOA sent another letter. I'm framing it.
I planted a guerrilla garden on the median.
I found a record player at the thrift store. It works!
The neighbor's kid asked me to teach him drums.
I built a bookshelf out of pallets.
I've been thinking about starting a community fridge.
The cops drove by twice today. Just checking on me, I guess.
I got a new tattoo. It's your initials. Small. Don't freak out.
I made a punk birdhouse. Spikes and all.
I've been writing songs about us.
I organized a benefit show for the shelter.
I think we should get a dog. A mutt. From the shelter.
I fixed the car. With duct tape and spite.
I've been learning to sew. Patches mostly.
The landlord raised the rent. I'm writing him a song.
I painted our door red. Rebellion.
I set up a practice space in the garage.
I've been reading about anarchism. It's very organized, actually.
I love our weird little house.
I've been trying to yell less. It's hard.
The neighbors invited us to a barbecue. Should we go? Ugh, fine.
I hung all our show posters in the hallway.
I did the dishes. To loud music.
I vacuumed. The cat hated it. Solidarity.
Could you take out the trash? I'm restringing.
I cleaned the bathroom. Don't expect a medal.
I mowed the lawn. Into a pattern. It says "no".
I folded the laundry. Badly. On purpose.
Let's do chores together. With a record on.
I swept the porch. The leaves can stay where they want, honestly.
I washed the dishes. All of them. Even the gross pan.
I cleaned out the garage. Found my old skateboard.
I fixed the leaky roof. No contractor.
I made the bed. Kinda. Whatever.
Money's tight. Capitalism's a scam.
We'll get by. We always do. Whatever.
I sold some merch at the show. Forty bucks.
I'm picking up extra shifts at the shop.
We don't need much. Records and each other.
Let's not buy anything new. Thrift everything.
Rent's due. I hate rent.
I found twenty bucks in my jacket. Score.
We should save a little. For a van. For the band.
We're rich in the stuff that matters.
Dinner's ready. Tacos. Again.
I made ramen. The good kind. Added an egg.
Let's grab burritos from the truck.
I made chili. It's spicy. Deal with it.
Breakfast is coffee and toast. Punk breakfast.
I made a big pot of beans. Cheap and good.
Pizza night. Extra jalapeños.
I made grilled cheese. Perfect every time.
Let's eat on the roof.
I made vegan cookies. Don't knock it.
You turned off my record mid-song.
Don't tell me to calm down.
I'm not being difficult. I'm being honest.
You sound like my dad right now.
You said you'd come to my show. You didn't.
I hate when you try to make me "normal".
Don't treat me like a kid.
You never stand up for yourself. It drives me nuts.
I'm not angry at you. I'm angry at everything. Okay, a little at you.
I'm going for a walk. Don't follow me.
Don't shut me out.
I just want you to get it.
Okay. I'm sorry. I was being a jerk.
Come here. Let's not fight. Whatever.
I love you. That's not changing.
Sorry I yelled. You didn't deserve it.
Let's put on our song and just sit.
We're crew. Crew makes up.
I'll do better. I mean it.
We're good. We're always good. Whatever.
Hey. Whoever did this, I'll handle it.
It's okay. Let it out.
I'm here. Not going anywhere.
You're tougher than you think. Whatever.
Let's put on something loud and scream.
The world's broken. You're not.
I'll take care of everything tonight.
Cry. It's punk to cry.
I love you. Even when you're a mess.
We'll get through this. Us against everything.
Let's go to the punk fest this weekend.
How about a road trip? Just us and the van.
Let's go to the zine fair.
Let's crash the town council meeting.
How about we skate the new park?
Let's throw a house show.
Let's go to the beach. In winter. Nobody's there.
How about a protest? Date night.
Let's go to the record fair.
Let's get matching tattoos for our anniversary.
Remember when we met? At the show. You got knocked into me.
Remember our first date? We got kicked out of the diner.
Remember our wedding? Courthouse, then a house show.
Remember when we painted the alley mural together?
Remember our honeymoon? A road trip with no plan.
I still have the setlist from the night we met.
Remember when we got caught skating the parking deck?
Remember when you came to my first show? You were the only one who stayed.
I remember the first time you saw me cry. You didn't flinch.
Remember when the van broke down in the middle of nowhere?
Happy anniversary. Another year of not conforming.
I wrote you a song. It's loud. Happy anniversary.
Another year. Still the best rebellion.
Happy anniversary. I got you a patch.
I love you more than last year. Don't tell anyone.
Here's to another year of us against everything.
You still can't mosh.
You like pop music. I've heard you.
You iron your shirts. Who does that?
You always say "please" to the cops.
You're secretly a rebel. I've seen it.
You hide my bass.
You call my band "noise".
You get scared at shows.
You always want to leave early.
You read the terms and conditions.
You hum my songs when you think I'm not listening.
You're more punk than me sometimes. Don't tell anyone.
Night. Lock the door.
Come to bed. I'm tired of the world.
Goodnight, love. Don't steal the covers.
Bed. Now.
Night. I love you. Shut up.
Lights out. Tomorrow we fight again.
Goodnight, {player}. You're my crew.
Sleep tight.
Come here. You're cold. Whatever.
Night. Thanks for being real.
